title: Gabito Ballesteros & La Joaqui’s ‘Báilame’ & More: Vote for the Best New Latin Music Release This Week
summary: Which new Latin music release is your favorite? Vote below!
contentText:
This week, Billboard’s New Music Latin poll — curated with key recommendations by Billboard Latin and Billboard Español editors — features a number of new albums, including Ednita Nazario’s FuegoAlmaVida , Oscar Maydon’s Música en mi Jetski and Kendo Kaponi’s comeback single, “Se Equivoca” in collaboration with Farruko. 

Gabito Ballesteros teamed up with La Joaqui on “Báilame,” a reggaetón-tinged cumbia villera that’s close to home to La Joaqui, but an experimental edge for Gabito. The song marks the second collaborative effort between the pair, following the romantic corrido “Nada Personal,” released earlier this year. 

In the captivating “Báilame,” the Mexican and Argentine singers are flirty and playful.  “We’re connected/ It was the perfect moment/ I’m jealous of the air that brushes against your skin, baby,” chants Gabito, while Joaqui responds: “Our eyes met/ You were just playing around/ We ended up together until the sun went down.”

Meanwhile, artists such as Hermanos Espinoza, Camila Fernández and Nesi have also dropped new music this week.

The most recent New Music Latin poll (published on July 10) was topped by Ha*Ash’s Latin country fusion “¿Qué Le Pongo?,” which earned more than 61% of the vote. Which release this week do you think is best? Give these new releases a spin, and vote for your favorite new Latin music release below.

Editor’s Note: The results of the weekly New Music Latin poll will be posted if the poll generates more than 1,000 votes. This poll closes at 11 a.m. ET on Monday, July 20.
